Every Access Provider shall establish facility for revoking the consent by its customers and shall make necessary arrangements: - to receive request, from the customer, for revoking the consent, if any, given by the recipient to the sender or to the consent acquirer for the purpose of receiving a commercial communication message or voice call; to provide modes, free of cost, to the customer, as per his choice, to revoke consent either by: - (i) sending SMS to short code 1909 with Label <Revoke> and <Sender ID> or to telephone number mentioned in the message or during the voice call received from the sender(s); or (ii) calling on 1909 or number mentioned for revoking the consent during the voice call received from the sender(s); or (iii) calling on customer care number; or (iv) Interactive Voice Response System (IVRS); or (v) Mobile app developed in this regard
title: 05 commercial communications consolidated
